questions.text: Do you live in a house or a flat?
questions.say: Good evening. My name is George, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about your home. Do you live in a house or a flat?

how it affects your daily life

questions.text: Describe a healthy habit you have or would like to have.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a healthy habit you have or would like to have. You should say: what the habit is; when you started it, or when you would like to start; how it affects your daily life; and explain why you think it is a healthy habit.

questions.text: Have you encouraged anyone else to do the same?
questions.say: Thank you. Have you encouraged anyone else to do the same?

questions.text: What are the most common unhealthy habits in your country?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a healthy habit, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all health and lifestyle. What are the most common unhealthy habits in your country?

questions.text: Why do people find it difficult to change bad habits?
questions.say: Why do people find it difficult to change bad habits?

questions.text: Are people today healthier than people fifty years ago?

questions.text: Should unhealthy food and drinks cost more?
questions.say: Now let's talk about health and the government. Should unhealthy food and drinks cost more?

questions.text: What should schools teach children about health?

questions.text: Should the government pay for people to use gyms and sports centres?
